worldcombat.skill.ragepowder.summary: Scatters a cloud of irritating powder over itself so enemies inside are repeatedly pulled onto the caster. Being a powder, Grass types are immune.
worldcombat.skill.ragepowder.use.0: Suck enemy fire off an ally with a cloud of powder
worldcombat.skill.ragepowder.use.1: Stick to nearby enemies so an ally can break away
worldcombat.skill.ragepowder.use.2: Cover a patch of open ground and hold the fight there
worldcombat.skill.ragepowder.description: Powder radius %1$s blocks, cloud lasts %2$s; enemies inside are repeatedly aimed at you. Grass types are immune.
worldcombat.skill.ragepowder.thick.on: Thick powder: radius x0.85, but pull interval x0.6 and duration x1.15 - small area, sticks hard.
worldcombat.skill.ragepowder.thick.off: Thin powder: radius x1.3 (wider), at the cost of interval x1.3 and duration x0.9 (looser).
worldcombat.skill.ragepowder.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
On (thick): radius x0.85, pull interval x0.6 and duration x1.15 (small, sticks hard). Off (thin): radius x1.3, interval x1.3, duration x0.9 (wide, looser).
The companion only powders when a living ally is inside this radius; lower powders only at close range, higher sucks fire off farther allies.
When an ally falls below this ratio, the powder counts as urgent and goes before ordinary combat; higher is more protective, lower waits until an ally is nearly down.
Below this ratio the companion stops drawing fire onto itself; lower takes more hits for others, higher protects itself first.
